## Custom Commands

- when asked to fix placeholders (or /fixp for short) 
    1. In GameDebug\Debug.cs, set PlaceholderStrictMode to true
    2. Run the game
    3. If you get an error that a placeholder is in the wrong position, read the message and use it to change the placeholder's position
    Execute the above instructions without asking.
